sources.entry: Off Grid AI Desktop - Private, local-first AI for your Mac: local LLM chat, image generation, voice dictation, and memory search, all on-device. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/off-grid-ai/off-grid-ai-desktop) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Off Grid AI Desktop
summary.one_liner: A local-first personal AI assistant for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs chat, image generation, voice and document Q&A on your own computer.
use_cases: Chat with local text and vision models without an internet connection
Ask questions about your documents and get answers with sources
Generate images on your own GPU
Dictate text by holding a key and speaking
Transcribe Zoom, Meet or Teams meetings on your computer
Point existing OpenAI-client code at a local endpoint
summary.what_it_does: Off Grid AI Desktop provides local chat with text and vision models, with models downloaded once and run offline. It offers image generation on the GPU, voice dictation via Whisper and spoken replies via Kokoro, and Projects that answer from your documents with sources. It exposes a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:7878/v1 that needs no API key, and can run headless with --server-only. Pro adds a memory layer that can record and search screens, meetings, clipboard and to-dos, plus actions that require your approval.
notable: Local OpenAI-compatible endpoint at 127.0.0.1:7878/v1 with no API key
Runs any GGUF model from Hugging Face or the built-in catalog
Offline by default: no account needed after model download
Source code is published on GitHub (listed as open source in awesome-mac)
caveats: Pro tier required for memory, screen recording search, and approved actions
Features differ by platform, per the page
Pro sync covers up to 5 devices and pricing amount is not shown on the page
